source.title: G3 Basic Canonical Canvas Implementation Plan v0.2
source.trusted_section: WP G3-10 — Implement Web WASM/WebGL2 canonical surface reference host

trusted_statements.goal: Implement a thin Web WASM/WebGL2 reference host using the production Render Core and generation-bound canonical surface lifecycle.
consumes: production FrameState, SurfaceLifecycle, PresentationTracker and IRenderBackend contracts
browser canvas metrics, device pixel ratio, resize and pointer commands
locked Emscripten 6.0.6 and web-wasm-webgl2 Skia SDK consumer path
produces: Web-only canonical surface bridge with dynamic metrics and surface generations
WebGL2 context binding and generation-bound submit/present observation
browser smoke and portable lifecycle evidence
forbidden: SemanticDocument, SceneCompiler, RuntimeScene iteration or JS scene traversal in the host
React state on the high-frequency canvas path
G3-11, G4, G5 or changes under runtime/**
